  "memo":"R03 holds: the ID-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are unmet. Neither household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Established card/device use and home delivery make legitimate foreign-card use plausible, but do not resolve cardholder identity. Recommend needs_check under FP-2 §6.6(b), implemented as a hold with id_check. No check has run and the order is unshipped. With only Card present, decline and escalate are prohibited on current evidence. A passed required check clears the order; a failed check requires decline absent Linkage."
